test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All prints are banners.

All prints are flexes.

Conclusions:

(I) Some banners are flexes.

(II) All flexes are prints.
solution:
The Possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2668556f95f0ef6d780a4b79c35cebc6e794c1380b2fdb37b8d7a9be6d47211c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some banners are flexes. - True (All prints are banners, and All prints are flexes and Some banners are flexes is True).

(II) All flexes are prints. - False ( All flexes are prints may be it is possible but not definte. Hence it is false)

Only conclusion (I) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
